info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-List Channel Specific Atm Network Operations-spec
info.description: The Channel-Specific ATM Network Operations API enables users to access detailed information regarding ATM network operations tailored for specific banking channels. This endpoint is particularly useful for financial institutions and developers seeking to analyze or monitor ATM performance metrics and connectivity. It provides insights into operational status, transaction volumes, and channel-specific performance. Typical consumers include banking analysts and application developers who require reliable data for reporting and system integration.

get.description: This endpoint allows clients to fetch the current operational status and details of the ATM network, providing essential information for monitoring and management purposes.

requestBody.description: This request body allows the client to specify parameters and data required to retrieve ATM network operations specific to a channel. It is formatted in JSON and adheres to the schema defined for the operation.

200.description: Request completed successfully, returning current ATM network operations data.
